# audio-device-router

> Policy layer that classifies audio devices, resolves capture and playback roles to devices with sticky choices, and reports hot-plug changes Python package `trysac-audio-device-router`, import name `audio_device_router`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
